notes.title: Level Editor?
notes.content:
Hi All,

I read your all feedback and suggestions. Most of you are right but don't worry. We are develop this game together.

Hocus was designed and developed for mobile devices. However, I want to use usability of desktop. For example, level editor.

Yes, You can create/play/share your own impossible shapes with very easy way.

What do you think? This is crazy, right?

notes.title: Level Editor?
notes.content:
Hi All,

I read your all feedback and suggestions. Most of you are right but don't worry. We are develop this game together.

Hocus was designed and developed for mobile devices. However, I want to use usability of desktop. For example, level editor.

Yes, You can create/play/share your own impossible shapes with very easy way.

What do you think? This is crazy, right?
